summary_1line: After the war, the Pandavas rule while honoring the defeated Dhritarashtra and Gandhari, though Bhima still harbors resentment over past injustices.

image_candidates.scene_text: The Pandava brothers bow at the feet of the blind king Dhritarashtra seated on a throne while attendants and queens stand respectfully around him.
Yudhishthira presents rich robes, garlands, and food to the aged Dhritarashtra as Gandhari and Kunti sit nearby in a solemn royal hall.
Bhima stands apart with a stern expression while his brothers respectfully attend the old blind king Dhritarashtra.
